\begin{assumption}[Fixed record queries]\label{ass:queries}
The public denominator satisfies $B=qn$, the expected minibatch size at
$D_0$, and is fixed across neighbors. It is not the realized Poisson batch
size. For each $a\in D_0$,
$g_a=\nabla f_a$, where
$f_a\in C^1(\R^d)$ and $g_a$ is globally Euclidean Lipschitz with constant
$L_a$. For every private input $D\subseteq\mathcal U$ and every
$j,k$, the release \eqref{eq:private-gradient} defines a measurable
probability kernel in the current state. No Lipschitz assumption is imposed
on queries for records outside $D_0$.
\end{assumption}

\subsection{Privacy calibration and learning-rate tuning}

Privacy accounting uses the same finite algorithms. Fix an integer order
$r\geq2$ and $0<\delta<1$. Let $\rho_r(q,\sigma)$ be the
sufficient sampled-Gaussian R\'enyi bound defined explicitly in
\eqref{eq:rdp}, and put
\[
 c_\delta=\frac{\log(1/\delta)}{r-1}.
\]

Proposition~\ref{prop:privacy} gives the finite accountant
$\varepsilon_j=T_j\rho_r(q,s_jB)+c_\delta$. Since
$c_s^2=\lambda/H$ and $B=qn$, its limit is
\[
 \varepsilon_j\longrightarrow\frac{r}{2n^2c_s^2}+c_\delta.
\]
Thus the limiting sufficient privacy bound depends on the noise
coefficient $c_s$. For a target $\varepsilon>c_\delta$ and public slack
$\zeta>0$, choose
\[
 c_s=\sqrt{\gamma_\varepsilon},\qquad
 \gamma_\varepsilon=\frac{(1+\zeta)r}{2n^2(\varepsilon-c_\delta)}.
\]
This calibration makes the limit strictly smaller than $\varepsilon$, so
all sufficiently large members satisfy the target privacy guarantee.

\paragraph{An explicit finite-run schedule.}
For any sequence of positive integers $T_j\to\infty$ and any $c_\eta>0$, set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:explicit-schedule}
 \boxed{
 s_j=\sqrt{\gamma_\varepsilon T_j},\qquad
 \eta_j=\frac{c_\eta}{\sqrt{T_j}},\qquad
 \sigma_{\mathrm{DP},j}=B\sqrt{\gamma_\varepsilon T_j}.}
\end{equation}
These choices satisfy the time-scaling relations in
Assumption~\ref{ass:clock} exactly, with
\[
 H=\frac{c_\eta}{\sqrt{\gamma_\varepsilon}},\qquad
 \lambda=c_\eta\sqrt{\gamma_\varepsilon}.
\]
This calibration sets the noise coefficient; $c_\eta$ is the remaining
learning-rate coefficient. More general families satisfying
Assumption~\ref{ass:clock} with these $H,\lambda$ are also covered.

structure Primitives (m d : ℕ) where
  dimensionPos : 0 < d
  beta : DPAdamMomentRatioInvariant.BetaSeparation
  beta1_pos : 0 < beta.beta1
  eps : ℝ
  C : ℝ
  q : ℝ
  eps_pos : 0 < eps
  C_pos : 0 < C
  q_pos : 0 < q
  q_le_one : q ≤ 1
  dataset : Finset (Fin m)
  dataset_nonempty : 0 < dataset.card
  query : (Fin d → ℝ) → Fin m → (Fin d → ℝ)
  recordConstant : Fin m → ℝ
  recordConstant_nonneg : ∀ r ∈ dataset, 0 ≤ recordConstant r
  query_lipschitz : ∀ theta theta' r, r ∈ dataset →
    Mf.DP.l2Norm (query theta r - query theta' r) ≤
      recordConstant r * Mf.DP.l2Norm (theta-theta')
  clipped_measurable : ∀ record, Measurable fun state : PrivateAdamState (Fin d) =>
    Mf.DP.l2VectorClip C (query state.1 record)

Tendsto (sourceData p x x0 gamma c hg hc T hT).literalSlowClockPathLaw atTop
      (𝓝 (sourceLaw p gamma c hg hc T hT hlim x x0)) := by
  apply (sourceData p x x0 gamma c hg hc T hT).calibratedLiteralSlowClockPathLaw_tendsto_namedCovariance
    (noise_limit p gamma c hg hc T hT x x0 hlim)
    (step_limit p gamma c hg hc T hT x x0) rfl _ x0
    (tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mp hx)
    (fixed_query_local_mean _ p.query (by intro n; rfl))

theorem solutionMap_independent_constant {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H) (drift : E → E) (L M : ℝ≥0)
    (hL : LipschitzWith L drift) (hM : LipschitzWith M drift) (initial : E) :
    solutionMap hH drift L hL initial = solutionMap hH drift M hM initial := by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro driver
  exact solutionPath_unique hH drift L hL initial driver _ _
    (solutionMap_isAdditiveSolution hH drift L hL initial driver)
    (solutionMap_isAdditiveSolution hH drift M hM initial driver)

theorem sourceMap_resample (q' : ℝ) (hq' : 0 < q') (hq1' : q' ≤ 1)
    (T' : ℕ → ℕ) (hT' : ∀ n, 0 < T' n) (hlim' : Tendsto T' atTop atTop) :
    sourceMap p gamma c hg hc T hT hlim x x0 =
      sourceMap (resample p q' hq' hq1') gamma c hg hc T' hT' hlim' x x0 := by
  apply solutionMap_independent_constant

theorem sourceLaw_resample (q' : ℝ) (hq' : 0 < q') (hq1' : q' ≤ 1)
    (T' : ℕ → ℕ) (hT' : ∀ n, 0 < T' n) (hlim' : Tendsto T' atTop atTop) :
    sourceLaw p gamma c hg hc T hT hlim x x0 =
      sourceLaw (resample p q' hq' hq1') gamma c hg hc T' hT' hlim' x x0 := by
  unfold sourceLaw
  simp only [sourceMap_resample p gamma c hg hc T hT hlim x x0 q' hq' hq1' T' hT' hlim']
  rfl

theorem paired_source_convergence (q' : ℝ) (hq' : 0 < q') (hq1' : q' ≤ 1)
    (T' : ℕ → ℕ) (hT' : ∀ n, 0 < T' n) (hlim' : Tendsto T' atTop atTop) :
    ∃ law : ProbabilityMeasure (ReferenceDriverPath d (c / Real.sqrt gamma)),
      Tendsto (sourceData p x x0 gamma c hg hc T hT).literalSlowClockPathLaw atTop (𝓝 law) ∧
      Tendsto (sourceData (resample p q' hq' hq1') x x0 gamma c hg hc T' hT').literalSlowClockPathLaw
        atTop (𝓝 law) := by
  refine ⟨_, source_convergence p gamma c hg hc T hT hlim x x0 hx, ?_⟩
  rw [sourceLaw_resample p gamma c hg hc T hT hlim x x0 q' hq' hq1' T' hT' hlim']
  exact source_convergence _ gamma c hg hc T' hT' hlim' x x0 hx

-- Data and original hypotheses only: no convergence/law conclusion is a field.
structure Inputs where
  m : Nat
  d : Nat
  p : LadonSourceConstructor.Primitives m d
  gamma : Real
  c : Real
  hg : 0 < gamma
  hc : 0 < c
  T : Nat → Nat
  Tnext : Nat → Nat
  hT : ∀ n, 0 < T n
  hTnext : ∀ n, 0 < Tnext n
  hlim : Tendsto T atTop atTop
  hlimnext : Tendsto Tnext atTop atTop
  x : Nat → Fin d → Real
  x0 : Fin d → Real
  hx : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 x0)
  qnext : Real
  hq : 0 < qnext
  hq1 : qnext ≤ 1

def commonLaw (a : Inputs) : Prop :=
  letI : Nonempty (Fin a.d) := ⟨⟨0, a.p.dimensionPos⟩⟩
  ∃ law : ProbabilityMeasure
      (DPAdamGaussianReferenceFunctionalLimit.ReferenceDriverPath a.d (a.c / Real.sqrt a.gamma)),
    Tendsto (LadonSourceConstructor.sourceData a.p a.x a.x0 a.gamma a.c a.hg a.hc a.T a.hT).literalSlowClockPathLaw
      atTop (𝓝 law) ∧
    Tendsto (LadonSourceConstructor.sourceData
      (LadonSourceConstructor.resample a.p a.qnext a.hq a.hq1) a.x a.x0 a.gamma a.c a.hg a.hc a.Tnext a.hTnext).literalSlowClockPathLaw
      atTop (𝓝 law)

theorem bridge (a : Inputs) : commonLaw a := by
  letI : Nonempty (Fin a.d) := ⟨⟨0, a.p.dimensionPos⟩⟩
  exact LadonSourceConstructor.paired_source_convergence a.p a.gamma a.c a.hg a.hc
    a.T a.hT a.hlim a.x a.x0 a.hx a.qnext a.hq a.hq1 a.Tnext a.hTnext a.hlimnext

theorem selected (a : Inputs) : commonLaw a := bridge a
